Actual Article Body:
By JACK TOLEDO and EMMA RICHTER, US SENIOR NEWS REPORTER

Published:  17:01 AEST, 7 October 2026   |  Updated:  21:40 AEST, 7 October 2026

Tennessee faced calls to abandon the execution of Christa Pike on Tuesday as the convicted killer became conscious in the hospital after her botched execution.

The 50-year-old had to be hooked up to a ventilator after the state failed to execute her through lethal injection on September 30.

But nearly a week later, the killer's attorneys said that she is reportedly 'conscious, speaking, and continues to receive critical medical care.'

'Despite the severe damage she endured to her arms, she is still handcuffed and shackled to the bed,' the lawyer said.

'Her recovery is medically unprecedented. Her prognosis remains unclear but, at a minimum, we expect a long recovery.'
